title: Latent Abstraction for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2604.17866v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a standard approach for enhancing large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, mitigating hallucinations, and improving factuality. However, existing systems rely on generating natural language queries at each hop and maintaining a strict architectural separation between retriever and generator, preventing them from leveraging the full representational capacity of the LLM. We propose \textbf{LAnR} (Latent Abstraction for RAG), a unified framework in which a single LLM jointly performs encoding, retrieval, and generation entirely within its own latent space. Rather than generating textual queries, LAnR produces dense retrieval vectors from the hidden states of a designated \texttt{[PRED]} token and uses them to match against encoded document representations from the same model. translated_title: 面向检索增强生成的潜在抽象方法

tldr: 该论文提出LAnR统一框架，让单个LLM通过指定[PRED]标记的隐藏状态直接生成密集检索向量，在其自身潜在空间内联合完成编码、检索与生成，从而摆脱了传统RAG中生成文本查询及检索器与生成器分离的架构限制。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes LAnR, a unified framework where a single LLM performs encoding, retrieval, and generation entirely within its own latent space by producing dense retrieval vectors from a designated [PRED] token's hidden states, eliminating the need for textual queries and the strict separation between retriever and generator in conventional RAG systems.
